events.title: August 31 Demo Update
events.summary: Hello everyone! This Demo update introduces new archetypes and forging progression, along with improvements to stages and the overall combat experience. Important Notice This Demo update upgrades the save format and is not compatible with saves from previous versions. After updating the Demo, you will need to reset your save when prompted.
